reviews.title: Absolutely unacceptable service. NEVER rely on Bolt if you have a flight to catch!
reviews.text:
I booked a taxi IN ADVANCE for an important international flight. At the very last minute, the driver simply cancelled my reservation, leaving me stranded with no transportation to the airport.

Because of Bolt’s failure, I was forced to urgently find another taxi at a significantly higher price, while risking missing my flight.

And the worst part? Their customer support is a complete joke.

Instead of helping, they told me to enable geolocation, even though my pickup address was clearly specified. Then they asked for screenshots of an “error” and repeatedly asked me to explain what happened.

There was NO technical error. YOUR DRIVER CANCELLED A CONFIRMED BOOKING!

What is the point of offering scheduled rides if customers cannot rely on them?

Bolt takes absolutely no responsibility when things go wrong. Their support is useless, their advance booking system is unreliable, and their apologies mean nothing.

I will never trust Bolt for an important trip again.

If you value your time, money, and peace of mind, DO NOT use Bolt for airport transfers.

reviews.text:
Lors d'une course à 16,30 € en octobre, Bolt m'a prélevé 56,90 €, en ajoutant 41 € au titre d'un « solde négatif » antérieur. Toutes mes courses précédentes avaient pourtant été payées, et mon historique ne montre aucun impayé.
J'ai contacté le support à plusieurs reprises. En quelques heures, quatre agents m'ont donné trois versions différentes : d'abord aucune course identifiable, puis des « opérations en attente », enfin trois transactions de 13,90 €, 10,70 € et 17,70 € introuvables dans mon historique, dont le total (42,30 €) ne correspond même pas aux 41 € prélevés. Le dernier agent a refusé de fournir le moindre détail supplémentaire et de rembourser.
Facturer une somme qu'on est incapable de justifier, puis enchaîner les réponses copiées-collées, n'est pas acceptable. Je conteste ce prélèvement auprès de ma banque. Vérifiez bien vos paiements si vous utilisez Bolt.

This is absolutely unacceptable. Customers spend a long time waiting for drivers who have already accepted their bookings, only to be abandoned at the last second.

What makes this even more frustrating is that these cancelled rides don’t appear in my trip history. I cannot access the driver’s profile, leave a complaint or report their behaviour.

How are customers supposed to report drivers when Bolt doesn’t even provide access to cancelled bookings?

Bolt needs to make every cancelled ride visible in the trip history, allow customers to report specific drivers and hold drivers accountable for this behaviour.

reviews.title: Sehr intransparent und permanente Änderungen der Mietbedingungen und Pässe
reviews.text:
Ich habe die E-Scooter von Bolt in der Vergangenheit regelmäßig genutzt, werde den Dienst ab sofort jedoch nicht mehr in Anspruch nehmen und kann ihn nach meinen persönlichen Erfahrungen nicht weiterempfehlen.
Unübersichtliche Tarifänderungen bei Pässen:
In der Vergangenheit nutzte ich regelmäßig Pässe mit einer Gültigkeit von 30 Tagen (z. B. 120 Minuten für ca. 12 Euro). Nach meinem Eindruck wurde die Tarifstruktur geändert, sodass die Gültigkeit bei vergleichbarem Preis nun auf 7 Tage verkürzt ist. Eine aus meiner Sicht deutliche oder hervorgehobene Information über diese gravierende Anpassung habe ich beim Buchungsvorgang vermisst. Wer aus Gewohnheit bucht, übersieht diese Reduzierung der Laufzeit leicht. Auf meine Kontaktaufnahme bzgl. einer Kulanzlösung reagierte der Kundenservice ablehnend und verwies lediglich auf die Eigenverantwortung bei der Buchung.
Mängel bei Wartung und Fahrzeugzustand:
Subjektiv hat auch die Qualität der Fahrzeuge nachgelassen. Ich habe wiederholt Scooter vorgefunden, die aus meiner Sicht unzureichend gewartet wirkten oder Mängel aufwiesen.
Abrechnung und Kundenservice:
In der Vergangenheit kam es bei meinen Fahrten vereinzelt zu fehlerhaften Abrechnungen. Den Kundenservice habe ich dabei als wenig entgegenkommend und schwer erreichbar erlebt.
Fazit:
Aufgrund der intransparenten Tarifanpassungen, der aus meiner Sicht nachlassenden Fahrzeugqualität und des enttäuschenden Kundenservice ziehe ich für mich persönlichen Konsequenzen und steige wieder

The driver was great, the ride was great, but the pickup was awful.  There is no system. Bolt is not an equal-access ride share app like it used to be. You must pay more than advertised to get a ride—this is why the prices seem so low, you don’t really register that you’re paying much more than you originally agreed to.

FINAL UPDATE: So, with all of the trackers, it seems Bolt admit that they are using your personal information to scam the most money out of you as possible instead of being an equal access ride share app. Think the priority access increases the fare payment to the driver? reviews.title: This is a fraudulent ride-hailing system.
reviews.text:
A ride-hailing app with no protection for customers.

The driver started charging before arriving at the pickup location, changed the route without my permission by taking a longer way, and even failed to end the trip after I got out of the car, resulting in additional charges.

I reported the issue, but no action was taken and the complaint was not properly handled.

I will not be changing my review because the issues I experienced are the result of flaws in your platform’s system.

Your system allows drivers to mark themselves as “arrived” before they actually reach the designated pickup location, creating the false impression that the passenger kept the driver waiting. It also allows drivers to change the route without justification—there were no roadworks, traffic congestion, or any other conditions that would require taking a longer route. In addition, the trip was not ended promptly after I got out of the vehicle, which resulted in extra charges.

I understand that your platform offers lower fares than other ride-hailing services, so I can accept that the service quality and vehicle standards may not be as good. However, I cannot accept drivers deliberately manipulating the system to increase their earnings. That feels no different from a scam.

For the sake of collecting a few extra dollars, your platform has thrown away its credibility. I no longer trust your service and will not be using it again.

This is a fraudulent ride-hailing system.

reviews.title: Bolt Priority Service - absolute scam
reviews.text:
I paid for a Priority ride because Bolt showed a pickup time of around 3 minutes. The standard option was significantly cheaper, but I was willing to pay extra because I needed a faster pickup. Bolt immediately charged me too of the range cost for a Priority ride and failed to provide a priority pickup. The app promised about 3 minutes; the driver arrived 12-15 minutes later.

What made the experience a lot worse was customer support. Every response focused on fare calculations, cashback, or discounts rather than the simple question: why should a customer pay the full premium price when the promised priority service was not provided?

The experience also highlighted a weakness in Bolt’s ETA and pickup technology. The app showed a nearby driver and a very short arrival time, but the actual pickup took much longer. This happens often enough that it feels like Bolt’s estimates do not properly account for routing, traffic conditions, and the practical reality of reaching the pickup point. The result is that customers are shown optimistic arrival times that do not match reality.

In the end, I paid a premium price, received a delayed pickup, spent considerable time arguing with support, and never received a meaningful explanation. I have cancelled my Bolt Plus subscription and will think twice before using Bolt again. Definitely never again Priority Service - do not recommend.

reviews.title: Unsafe ride and unacceptable customer service
reviews.text:
This was my first time using Bolt and it will also be my last. I took a cab because I was already feeling unwell and the weather was bad, so I didn’t want to take public transport in the rain. Unfortunately, this ride made me feel much worse.

I was quoted around $32 but charged closer to $39 for a short 12 km trip. The estimated time was 20 minutes, yet the ride took over an hour. The driver repeatedly took wrong turns and went around in circles, which significantly extended the trip and increased the fare. He was on a phone call for most of the ride, though I don’t mind that, but I believe it may have distracted him and contributed to losing the route.

The driving felt unsafe and rash, with near-misses involving other vehicles and frequent honking from other drivers. I felt anxious and nauseous during the ride and physically sick afterwards.

When I reported this as a health and safety issue, customer support refused a full refund simply because the trip was “completed,” dismissing both the unsafe driving and its impact on my health. I was forced to accept a partial refund just to end the conversation.

I will never use Bolt again. I would rather pay more for another cab service than use an app that does not take passenger safety or customer health seriously.

reviews.title: Dangerous lack of emergency support
reviews.text:
I accidentally left my phone behind in a car and tried to get help from Bolt anyway I could - I filled in the online form, emailed two different addresses, called two different numbers, I even asked other Bolt drivers if they could help me get in touch with anyone from the support team. I had 19 hours until my flight home and was about to be stranded in a foreign country. The only thing I needed was my driver's phone number. I was told that I can expect a response either immediately or within an hour. All I received was silence.

Despite Bolt's refusal to help, I used Apple's native features to track down my phone and retrieve it from the driver before my flight.

Bolt finally responded to my email 5 hours too late. 

I wanted to thank my driver for making up for Bolt's shortfalls and helping me return home safely, but Bolt refused to let me tip him through the app. I had to again resolve this situation myself.

I have had good experiences with Bolt drivers and find their independent contractors reliable, but Bolt as a company has been absolutely horrific. To not have a single functioning support channel is unacceptable and borderline dangerous. I will be deleting the app after this incident, because it is clear that Bolt does not take any responsibility for looking after its users.

reviews.title: No help from customer support
reviews.text:
I had a very unpleasant and stressful experience with Bolt. My driver arrived far from the pick-up point, refused to drive to the correct location, and demanded that my sister and I walk to him instead. When we reached the car, he was extremely rude and aggressive, raised his voice, and even got out of the vehicle to argue. He refused to take us, shouted even louder when I asked him to calm down, and then simply left us standing on the street.

This behaviour is completely unacceptable and violates Bolt’s safety and conduct policies. The driver failed to ensure passenger safety, refused service without any reason, and acted in a way that made us feel unsafe and disrespected. The situation caused significant emotional distress for both me and my sister, and it seriously affected my trust in Bolt’s service and safety standards.

I reported this incident to Bolt’s safety team, but unfortunately, I did not receive any real support or assurance that appropriate action would be taken. This was very disappointing and made me feel that passenger safety is not being taken seriously.
